Export statci AST lint results to SARIF 2.1.0 JSON

Source: R/sarif.R
export_statci_sarif.Rd

Serializes a "statci_lint" object (or the lint component of a "statci_report") into a valid Static Analysis Results Interchange Format (SARIF) 2.1.0 JSON log compatible with GitHub Code Scanning (github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3) for inline pull-request annotations.

Usage

export_statci_sarif(
  lint,
  output_file = NULL,
  base_uri = NULL,
  tool_version = NULL
)

Arguments

lint

A "statci_lint" object from stat_lint() / stat_lint_dir() or a "statci_report" containing a lint component.

output_file

Optional path to write the .sarif JSON file. If NULL (default), returns the serialized SARIF 2.1.0 JSON string.

base_uri

Optional base project directory path stripped from file paths so artifact URIs are clean repository-relative paths.

tool_version

Optional tool version string (defaults to the installed statci package version).

Value

If output_file is NULL, returns a character scalar of SARIF 2.1.0 JSON; otherwise writes the file and returns output_file invisibly.

Examples

lint_res <- stat_lint_text("x <- rnorm(10)\n")
sarif_json <- export_statci_sarif(lint_res)
parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(sarif_json)
parsed$version
#> [1] "2.1.0"
